text.offer: D'Franco says, "Sooner or later every traveller asks me where they ought to settle. I tell them all the same thing: go to the Hall of Genealogy and read the histories of the great towns. Tos, Barloque, Jasper, Marion, Raza and Cor Noth: each has its own people, its own story and its own advantage for those who call it home. The townsfolk treat their own a little better."
text.complete: Thousands of books in that hall, and only a handful that matter to a traveller. Read them when you have the time, and choose your hometown well.

steps.brief: The Hall of Genealogy is in Cor Noth. Inside, read the histories of the great towns; each one ends with the advantage its citizens get. When you are sure, the hall tells you what to say to make one your hometown.
